title: Avoid primary-key row type uppercase allocation
description: Replace primary_key_row_from_id's primary-key data type to_ascii_uppercase allocation with borrowed type-name matching.

criteria: Primary-key row reconstruction no longer allocates uppercase data type strings
Integer, DATE, TIMESTAMP(...), and DATETIME primary-key row-id decoding remains case-insensitive where supported
String fallback for unsupported or undecodable row ids remains unchanged
Primary-key lookup, projection, and order regressions pass

notes: primary_key_row_from_id now borrows schema column data_type as &str instead of allocating an uppercase String.
primary_key_row_from_parts now uses is_integer_type_name, eq_ignore_ascii_case, and a local ASCII case-insensitive prefix helper.
Data key construction, row-id parsing, row cache behavior, and ordered row-id handling are unchanged.
